<!-- Generated by scripts/build-api-reference.mjs from the SDK's source: do not edit. -->

Joins `@babulvaibhav/egradx-notification` to `@babulvaibhav/egradx-auth`, as the Java `egradx-notification-auth` joins the Java libraries.

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `notificationsWithAuth(auth, options)` | Completes the options for `createNotifications` with:<ul><li>the notification authorities, added to auth's catalog;</li><li>the account-message types and templates;</li><li>the resolvers below.</li></ul> |
| `connectAccountMessages(auth, notifications)` | Sends auth's messages through notification, with Java's templates and the same model: password reset, invitation, email-change code, email changed, password changed, contact verification, and the sign-in code, sign-up code and sign-in-method-added notice (`egradx.auth.sign-in-code`, `.signup-code`, `.sign-in-method-added`; its sender answers `sendsSignInMessages()` true). |
| `notificationResolvers(auth)` | The resolvers on their own:<ul><li>viewers and actors: who is calling;</li><li>recipients: a user's addresses, from their profile contacts;</li><li>the directory: who is in an organization, for bulk sends;</li><li>preferences: opt-outs.</li></ul> |
| `accountMessageTypes()`, `ACCOUNT_TEMPLATES` | The types and the template folder, packaged from `contracts/notification-templates/egradx-notification-auth/`. |

```ts
const notifications = createNotifications(notificationsWithAuth(auth, { prisma, types: myTypes }));
connectAccountMessages(auth, notifications);
```

### notificationResolvers()

  | "viewers"
  | "actors"
  | "recipientResolver"
  | "recipientDirectory"

### notificationsWithAuth()

```ts
function notificationsWithAuth(auth, options): NotificationsOptions;
```

Connects egradx-notification to egradx-auth, as Java's egradx-notification-auth does by being on the
classpath. Before createNotifications (and before auth.start()), it contributes the notification
authorities and adds the resolvers, the account-message types and their templates to the options:

  const notifications = createNotifications(notificationsWithAuth(auth, { prisma, types: [...] }));
  connectAccountMessages(auth, notifications);

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `auth` | [`Auth`](/docs/reference/node/egradx-sdk#auth) |
| `options` | [`NotificationsOptions`](/docs/reference/node/egradx-sdk#notificationsoptions) |

#### Returns

[`NotificationsOptions`](/docs/reference/node/egradx-sdk#notificationsoptions)
